name: WordPress Publisher
description: Publish, update, or schedule the current note as a WordPress post, with images uploaded to the Media Library.

zh-CN.name: WordPress 发布
zh-CN.description: 将当前笔记发布、更新或定时发布为 WordPress 文章，并把图片上传到媒体库。

author: Dariusz Koryto

fields.label: WordPress site URL
fields.description: The address of your site, for example https://blog.example.com. HTTPS is required; http:// is accepted only for localhost.

zh-CN.label: WordPress 站点网址
zh-CN.description: 站点地址，例如 https://blog.example.com。必须使用 HTTPS；仅 localhost 可使用 http://。

fields.label: Application Password
fields.description: Create one in WordPress under Users → Profile → Application Passwords. Do not use your login password.
fields.placeholder: xxxx xxxx xxxx xxxx xxxx xxxx

zh-CN.label: 应用程序密码
zh-CN.description: 在 WordPress 的“用户 → 个人资料 → 应用程序密码”中创建。请勿使用登录密码。

fields.label: Default post status
fields.description: Used by “Publish current note to WordPress”.

zh-CN.label: 默认文章状态
zh-CN.description: 用于“将当前笔记发布到 WordPress”命令。

fields.label: Default categories
fields.description: Optional. Comma-separated category names or IDs. Missing names are created if your account may manage categories.

zh-CN.label: 默认分类
zh-CN.description: 可选。以逗号分隔的分类名称或 ID。若账号有权限，不存在的分类会自动创建。

fields.label: Upload note images to the Media Library
fields.description: Images and attachments in the note are uploaded once and linked from the post.

zh-CN.label: 将笔记图片上传到媒体库
zh-CN.description: 笔记中的图片和附件只上传一次，并在文章中引用。

fields.label: Use the first image as the featured image

zh-CN.label: 将第一张图片设为特色图片
